body:
Candidate for bd-01M17B5EQ0R3KAA79CSN1AT18Y.

SHA: 08c26d8e9c86659c45c0ca9029d7d803a0a7a26c
branch: absorb-unabsorbed-tolerance
worktree: /tmp/storymodel4s-absorb-tolerance
base: 6f69ec6. main has since moved to ae7f59e (B1+B2 + ADR 0004). Touched paths do not overlap; I did not rebase.

What changed
- PlacementResolution.of: if |sum-1| is inside Tolerance, divide all three parts so the stored triple is the admitted partition. 0.4+0.0 stays Left. Residual-on-last is not used (1-r-u can go slightly negative and would publish a mass of() itself refuses).
- ValidatedVector.of(L2): if |norm-1| is inside NormTolerance, divide by n so the stored vector satisfies the L2 claim. NormTolerance stays 1e-6.
- Both guards are fail-closed under NaN (<=), and fold math.ulp(1.0) so the constructed literals 1±tol are the stated boundary. Measured: (1.0+1e-9)-1.0 is 1.000000082740371e-9, which misses 1e-9 without the ulp; (1.0-1e-6)-1.0 misses 1e-6 the same way. 1+2*tol still rejects on both sites.

Occurs unmeasured. Reading the branch established permission only.

Pins
- 1+Tolerance absorbs; 1+2*Tolerance is Left (both sites, both signs).
- Gap-filling 0.4+0.0 still refused.
- Near-unit L2 Vector(1+5e-7,0,0,0) now stores norm within 1e-15, not the original 5e-7 miss.

Not touched
- D1 holds (identity.scala, embedprobe, Gens.scala, acquire prompts).
- signature.scala / align trio.
- NormTolerance value.

Gate (unpiped; GATE_EXIT appended to the log)
Export: git archive 6f69ec6 overlayed with the four dirty files, then committed as 08c26d8. 27 top-level entries, build.sbt present.
1. interviewJVM/test; embedCoreJVM/test → GATE_EXIT=0. interview 92, embed-core 138.
2. compileAll; interviewJS/test; interviewNative/test; embedCoreJS/test; embedCoreNative/test; embedGrakern/test; scalafmtCheckAll (format last) → GATE_EXIT=0.
   interview JS/Native 92+92, embed-core JS/Native 138+138, embedGrakern 28.
   Logs: /tmp/storymodel4s-absorb-jvm.log, /tmp/storymodel4s-absorb-gate-full.log.

Reference scope: interview and embed-core own the types; embed-grakern and embed-bench mention ValidatedVector (compileAll covered both; embedGrakern tests run). laws does not reference either type.

Ready for chief merge of 08c26d8 onto current main.
